subject: Re: VPC evaluation — conditional sponsorship & evidence timeline
body:
From: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@pinebrook.health>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: VPC evaluation — request for conditional sponsorship and timeline

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Private VPC flow looks like a good fit for our production pilot. We have a couple of security gating items from our InfoSec and procurement teams before we can start ingesting PHI-like test records into a Redwood-managed environment:

- SOC 2 / security summary (high level + scope)
- Recent penetration test summary (last 12 months, redacted findings ok)
- Confirmation of egress controls and KMS integration options

We are under a timebox for the quarter and wanted to ask whether Redwood can sponsor additional evaluation credits and a short trial extension while we complete the paperwork. Specifically: 50k token credits (to cover a week of synthetic load + kernel profiling) and a 2–3 week extension of the POC window.

We can share the SOC 2 summary and pen-test overview under NDA; want to know what else you need to move an internal credit approval. Can you also share a target timeline for the compliance review on your side?

Thanks,
Aisha Thomas
Director, Data & Security
Pinebrook Health

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@pinebrook.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC evaluation — request for conditional sponsorship and timeline

Hi Aisha — appreciate the clear ask and the security context. We can absolutely support a conditional sponsorship pending verification of the artifacts you referenced. High level next steps from our side:

1) Please send the SOC 2 summary and the pen-test overview (redacted is fine).
2) Our security team (cc'd) will run a quick checklist against those docs; if anything else is required we'll list it.
3) Assuming the artifacts meet our baseline, we can provision a one-time 50k token credit allotment and extend the POC window by three weeks.

To set expectations: the compliance check is typically 3–5 business days for the docs you mentioned. If there are follow-up items (e.g., full pen-test report or firewall rules), that could take longer.

If you're available, let's do a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the checklist and confirm dates. Proposed times: 10:00 AM or 2:00 PM PT.

I'll also loop Kimberly for billing/credit approval so we can get a promo code staged if security signs off.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@pinebrook.health>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: RE: VPC evaluation — request for conditional sponsorship and timeline

Hi Aisha / Vivek — looping in initial security checklist so you know what I will validate. I put the checklist in the attachment (security_checklist_v1.pdf) but key items below:

- SOC 2 Type II scope & date + auditor name (summary ok)
- Penetration test date, scope, and whether findings were remediated; redacted report acceptable
- KMS: supported providers and whether customer-managed keys are permitted (we support AWS KMS + GCP KMS customer-managed keys in Private deployments)
- Network controls: egress allowlist architecture and whether you require strict IP whitelisting for control-plane APIs
- Data residency: confirmation of region and retention settings for KV/metrics (Pinebrook noted US-only)
- Any additional vendor questionnaires (SIG/BSIG) you require — we can handle the standard fields but large bespoke forms may take 5–7 business days

If the SOC2 summary and pen-test overview look good, I can sign off on the credit sponsorship conditionally (internal approval) and mark it as "security-approved pending confirmation". If you want, I can run a 20-min technical workshop to walk an engineer through the egress and KMS setup.

Ben Carter
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attachment: security_checklist_v1.pdf)

---

From: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@pinebrook.health>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: VPC evaluation — request for conditional sponsorship and timeline

Thanks Ben — attached are the two items you asked for: SOC2_summary.pdf (scope: infrastructure + data platform; Type II audit 2025, auditor: Radnor LLP) and pen_test_overview.txt (high level, internal contractor redaction applied). We also included a short note on our required egress posture (IP-based allowlist for external control-plane callbacks) and confirm US-only data residency.

We'd prefer the POC extension through 2026-12-31 if possible to accommodate our internal sign-off windows. The MOU for a short data processing addendum is in DocuSign (link below) — we can sign as soon as you confirm the credit/top-up.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/MOU/PD-48291

Could you confirm by end-of-day Friday if Redwood can issue the promo code + extension assuming the attached artifacts check out? That would let procurement close our side quickly.

Best,
Aisha

(attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, pen_test_overview.txt)

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@pinebrook.health>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: VPC evaluation — request for conditional sponsorship and timeline

Hi Aisha — thanks for the uploads and for the clear deadline. Ben and I reviewed the SOC2 summary and the pen-test overview. Summary of decisions:

- Security: conditional approval granted. SOC2 scope and pen-test overview meet our baseline for a sandboxed Private deployment; no high-severity open findings presented.
- KMS & egress: customer-managed KMS supported; egress allowlist approach acceptable. Ben will hold a 30-min workshop next week to confirm network settings.
- Credits & extension: we will provision a one-time 50,000 token promotional credit and extend your POC end date to 2027-01-15 to give your team runway to complete procurement.

Next steps (action owners):
- Kimberly Park (cc) will generate a promo code and alert billing to apply it: promo code RBW-SNS-50K-PI.
- Ben Carter will schedule the technical workshop (I gave him permission to pull a calendar invite).
- Aisha / Pinebrook: sign the MOU in DocuSign and confirm the scoped region (US) for retention settings.

Kimberly — can you create the promo in HubSpot and issue the code today so Aisha's procurement can see it in their pipeline? HubSpot deal ref: https://hubspot.com/deal/1247.

Thanks everyone — happy to jump on a quick call if anything needs to be clarified.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

(attachments referenced earlier: SOC2_summary.pdf, pen_test_overview.txt, security_checklist_v1.pdf)
